author: BJ intake (abstracted)
concept: Narrow context per agent beats one overloaded context
summary: Give each agent its own narrow context, tool allowlist, and system prompt rather than overloading one general context. Specialists with bounded scope outperform a single generalist on multi-part work.
usable_principle: Delegate to scoped specialists: per-agent context, tool allowlist, and prompt. Keep each agent's job narrow.
sniped_relevance: How this OS runs its own workflows. Reusable for any multi-step BASEPLATE automation or content pipeline.

author: BJ intake (abstracted)
concept: Status plus block links as a coordination primitive
summary: Each task carries a status (pending, in-progress, complete) and explicit block / blocked-by links, so workers can pick up unblocked work automatically and the system self-coordinates.
usable_principle: Coordinate multi-step work with a dependency graph: status per task plus block/blocked-by links, so the next unblocked task is always pickable.
sniped_relevance: Applies to the OS batch pipeline and any operator automation. The pattern behind the workflow pipeline() primitive.

author: BJ intake (abstracted)
summary: For hard problems, spin up several independent agents on competing hypotheses, force them to critique each other, and converge. Diversity plus adversarial pressure beats a single confident pass.
usable_principle: For hard or high-stakes problems, run several independent agents on competing hypotheses and make them critique to convergence.
sniped_relevance: The OS adversarial-verify pattern. Reusable for decision memos, reviews, and any claim that must be trusted.

author: Gary Vaynerchuk (abstracted)
concept: Algorithmic relevance, not follower count, drives reach
summary: Modern platforms surface content by relevance to current attention, not by follower count. Creative quality is the variable that controls reach. A small account can reach large audiences if the creative earns it.
usable_principle: Optimize for interest-media reach: the creative, not the follower count, determines distribution. Make the work good enough that the algorithm carries it.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED content strategy and the platform-split doctrine. Removes the follower-count excuse; the lever is creative quality.

author: Gary Vaynerchuk (abstracted)
concept: Validate organic, then amplify proven winners
summary: Validate creative on real organic views (quantitative plus qualitative) first, then apply paid media only to amplify what already proved out. Never pay to distribute unvalidated creative.
usable_principle: Creative-first: prove the creative organically on real views, then put paid spend only behind validated winners.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED paid-vs-organic decision. Protects budget and forces creative discipline before spend.

author: Gary Vaynerchuk (abstracted)
concept: The edge lives in the uncrowded channel
summary: Incumbents overspend on yesterday's proven metrics, leaving newer channels underpriced. Run experiments in the uncrowded channel where attention is cheap before it reprices.
usable_principle: Hunt underpriced attention: the channel everyone has not crowded into yet is where reach is cheapest. Experiment there early.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED channel selection and the hit-mechanics distribution frame. Pairs with the mispricing-as-edge decision-system chunk.

author: BJ intake (abstracted)
summary: Hero outcome with a quantified multiplier, a benefit triad, a negative-positioning block, feature pills, a pricing ladder, and founder credibility. A reusable skeleton for any offer page.
usable_principle: Build offer pages on a fixed skeleton: hero outcome + quantified multiplier, benefit triad, negative-positioning block, feature pills, pricing ladder, founder credibility.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED Carrd/site and BASEPLATE dossier landing pages. Operationalizes the web-deployment map.

author: BJ intake (abstracted)
concept: Define the offer by what it refuses
summary: Differentiate by stating what the offer is not (not a feed, no noise, no scrolling) rather than competing feature-for-feature. Refusal sharpens identity and signals confidence.
usable_principle: Position by negation: name what you refuse to be. Differentiation by refusal beats feature comparison.
sniped_relevance: Reinforces the SNIPED refusal-positioning lever and WWP selectivity. Pairs with positioning-phrases.

author: BJ intake (abstracted)
concept: Free cap funnels to throughput-framed paid tiers
summary: A free tier with a hard usage cap funnels users to paid tiers framed by throughput rather than raw price. Framing on capability/throughput, not dollars, reduces price resistance.
usable_principle: Ladder pricing by throughput: a capped free tier into paid tiers framed on capability, not on price alone.
sniped_relevance: Relevant if any SNIPED/BASEPLATE digital product or AI tool gets packaged. Complements the Blair Enns 3-option architecture.

author: creator (abstracted)
concept: Fuse two distinct registers into one frame
summary: Keep a running reference/swipe folder, then before producing, deliberately fuse two distinct registers into one concept rather than copying one. Fusion produces an original look from borrowed parts.
usable_principle: Swipe-file fusion: maintain a reference library, then combine two distinct registers into a single concept before shooting, so the look is original not imitative.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED Track B composite and the lineage doctrine (work from inside the lineage, fuse rather than copy). Pairs with Edit Moves.

author: creator (abstracted)
concept: Decide the single entry point for the gaze
summary: Choose the one place the viewer's eye should land first (eyes or mouth), then brighten and emphasize it deliberately so the image controls where attention goes. An image should not leave the gaze undirected.
usable_principle: Set an attention hierarchy in post: pick the single entry point for the gaze and emphasize it so the frame directs the eye on purpose.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED edit doctrine and the luxury-edit pass. Complements the Edit Moves attention principles.

author: creator (abstracted)
concept: Lock the look before the shoot, not in post
summary: Brainstorm and lock the intended look before the shoot so editing executes a decision rather than searching for one. Post becomes execution, not exploration.
usable_principle: Concept before capture: decide the final look before shooting so post executes a locked decision instead of hunting for one.
sniped_relevance: SNIPED Direction Stack and pre-shoot prep. Reduces edit time and raises consistency across a body of work.
